pieces.name: Stone foundation
pieces.description: A raised stone plinth, 2 x 2 m. Everything else builds on it; it sits into slopes.

pieces.name: Timber floor
pieces.description: Planks on joists. A floor for a veranda, or upstairs on top of walls.

pieces.name: Mud brick wall
pieces.description: Sun-dried mud bricks on a dark plinth. 2 m wide, 2.5 m high.

pieces.name: Plastered wall
pieces.description: Mud brick under a coat of lime plaster: cooler inside, brighter outside.

pieces.name: Mud wall with door
pieces.description: A mud wall with a doorway. Fit a door into it.

pieces.name: Plastered wall with window
pieces.description: A plastered wall with a window opening. Fit a window into it.

pieces.name: Timber post
pieces.description: A timber post for verandas and lean-tos, 2.5 m.

pieces.name: Timber beam
pieces.description: A 2 m beam: lay it across posts to carry a roof.

pieces.name: Corrugated metal roof
pieces.description: Rusty corrugated sheets on rafters. Put the low edge on a wall top.

pieces.name: Thatched roof
pieces.description: Dry grass thatch, thick and cool. Put the low edge on a wall top.

pieces.name: Timber stairs
pieces.description: Three steps up to a foundation or a veranda.

pieces.name: Veranda railing
pieces.description: A railing for the edge of a veranda.

pieces.name: Timber fence
pieces.description: A rough fence for kraals and gardens. Fences join end to end.

pieces.name: Plank door
pieces.description: A plank door on a hinged frame. Snaps into a doorway; E opens and closes it.

pieces.name: Shuttered window
pieces.description: A framed window with bars and painted shutters. Snaps into a window opening.

pieces.name: Generator
pieces.description: A diesel generator. Powers lamps within 16 m while it has fuel; it starts empty.

pieces.name: Lamp post
pieces.description: A street lamp. Needs a generator within 16 m to be built; lit while that generator runs.

pieces.name: Fuel barrel
pieces.description: 20 litres of diesel. Set it down within 4 m of a generator to fill its tank.

pieces.name: Rondavel hut
pieces.description: A whole round hut (a glTF model with textures and a material file): its icon is rendered from the model.
